name: assessing-a-candidate
description: Use when an independent examiner must judge complete witnessed competency coverage for one exact enrollment and baseline, without relying on task counts, confidence, reputation, model family, or the trainers' own verdict.
preconditions: the examiner did not instruct or mentor this candidate
the baseline and all submitted witnesses resolve
every baseline competency is in the assessment denominator
postconditions: one Assessment records demonstrated or not-demonstrated for every competency
limitations and missing witnesses are explicit
qualified is possible only when every competency is independently demonstrated
